hypothesis: In the supplied two-dimensional, compressible, single-fluid resistive-MHD island-coalescence model, with uniform magnetic diffusivity eta, fixed initial state and boundaries, the normalized inverse-resistivity control is S_eta=1/eta. For mesh-qualified, pre-plasmoid cases with S_eta in [250,4000], the flux-window-averaged reconnection rate R has a log-slope in the band [-0.55,-0.45]. For a declared contrast Sa<Sb, p_eff=[ln R(Sb)-ln R(Sa)]/[ln Sb-ln Sa] must lie in that band after accounting for numerical uncertainty. Define R=(0.05-0.01)/(t(psi_rec=0.05)-t(psi_rec=0.01)) using the same initial-state-subtracted reconnected flux and normalization for both cases. The exponent may vary between contrasts: this hypothesis does not require an exact global power law or posit a probability distribution for exponents. A qualified contrast with its numerical-uncertainty interval wholly outside the band is a counterexample. Test this claim and, if it fails, investigate a minimal explanatory repair with a prediction challenged by fresh simulations.

Recomputing the prospectively approved deterministic uncertainty envelope, including conservative transport from the S2000 512² control, gives relative rate allowances of 1.3076% and 2.3909%. Endpoint propagation yields [-0.43140540,-0.32467595], wholly above -0.45. The five-setting exploratory map and declared selection rule targeted this contrast before refinement; production followed method approval. Recorded solver provenance shows diagnostic and retention changes without solver development. Actual complete-window evolution, multiple meshes, shrinking final rate changes, improving matched-flux profiles and completed CFL controls provide relevant commissioning. Production initial fields are identical; runtime resistivity and boundaries agree with the declared model. Recomputed conservation drifts are small, retained states are positive, and all saved magnetic frames through the actual upper brackets contain one X and two O points. Both production output_findings lists are empty. Qualification remains limited to an empirical numerical envelope, CFL sensitivity transferred from 256², saved-field topology, and unavailable separate floor/energyFix accounting; these do not block this bounded counterexample. This verdict establishes neither a global scaling law nor a repaired prediction. Accepting the original falsification does not depend on completing a later repair.
